text:
Updated a few duration typos:

The Quantum Autumn Sale is BACK
We are excited to launch PHASE 1 of the Quantum Autumn Sale to introduce jetpacks, backpacks, cosmetics... and a brand new vehicle! ALL assets will be available on Base and Cardano.
Start time: Nov. 1st - 15:00 UTC
Link: https://cornucopias.io/marketplace

Transak Integration
In this sale, we have a new feature available to create a super easy way for users to get their cryptocurrencies before the sale! With the help from our friends at u/Transak, the Cornucopias community can now buy/sell crypto with a credit/debit card!

Tier 1 / OGs
Our whitelisted community members will get a 1 hour head start on the sale for items in the Vehicle & Jetpack categories ONLY. All other items will be available for public sale at the same time as the tier 1 sale beginning at 15:00 UTC. Vehicle & Jetpacks sales will open up to the public at 16:00 UTC.

Quantum Jack
This head piece is a SEASONAL exclusive that will only be available in the Quantum Autumn Sale for anyone that claims it.
Total Supply: 20,000
Category: Head
Rarity: Common
Price: FREE + Tx Fee
Currency: $ADA / $ETH (Base)
Timeframe: Nov. 1st-21st

Valkyrie F9-R 2024
The F9-R is the first introduction of S-Class vehicles to our Cornucopias universe that will usher in a new era of speed to the race tracks!
Total Supply: 3,000
Category: Vehicle
Rarity: Variable
Price: $95
Currency: $ADA / $USDC
Timeframe: Nov. 1st-8th

Zero G Stratos
For the first time, the Cornucopias community will be able to explore this vast world using jetpacks manufactured by the best in the business.
Total Supply: 3,000
Category: Jetpack
Rarity: Rare
Price: $20
Currency: $ADA / $USDC
Timeframe: Nov. 1st-8th

Rando's Metalworks Junker Jet
This new manufacturer is making its Cornucopias debut with a new style of jetpack that is compiled using scrap from the Earth's surface.
Total Supply: 9,000
Category: Jetpack
Rarity: Uncommon
Price: $18
Currency: $ADA / $USDC
Timeframe: Nov. 1st-8th

Kargo Outfitters Titan XL
Also hitting Cornucopias markets for the first time is Kargo Outfitters bringing you the Titan XL backpack, for all your heavy-duty transport needs!
Total Supply: 2,600
Category: Backpack
Rarity: Rare
Price: $30
Currency: $COPI
Timeframe: Nov. 1st-21st

Corn Cuties Grizzly Backpacks
Corn Cuties are bringing a cute new feel to your avatar's style with the Purple Fury and Brown Brawler backpacks.
Total Supply: 3,000 (each)
Category: Backpack
Rarity: Rare
Price: $10
Currency: $COPI
Timeframe: Nov. 1st-21st

Burger Barn Deluxe #1
The makers of the best burgers in Cornucopias are bringing you this collectible head piece to commemorate the legacy of Burger Barn in Calido Valley!
Total Supply: 7,600
Category: Head
Rarity: Rare
Price: $5
Currency: $ADA/$USDC
Timeframe: Nov. 1st-21st

A NEW Adventure Begins SOON
We're excited to share with you the biggest updated that we've ever pushed and we hope you enjoy it! Share your favorite Phase 1 product coming to the Quantum Autumn sale and visit our marketplace to be prepared for launch!
Link: https://cornucopias.io/marketplace
